text:
ana: Heads-up — seeing a bunch of traces drop their parent when gateway publishes to Kafka and the worker re-creates spans. waterfall is broken, root shows up but the async children are orphaned.
josh: repro steps?
ana: gateway receives /generate, creates span, publishes message to topic. worker consumes, starts a new span but no parent info arrives. Looks like we rely on message attributes but our producer lib strips headers during batching.
priya: ugh. this is the classic async handoff problem. options: 1) try to transmit full W3C traceparent/tracestate in message attributes 2) send a compact handoff token that workers decode and reparent 3) create a new local span and attach a link back to original (no reparent)
kevin: preference for links — avoids changing parent-child semantics if the worker does long lived processing and we want the gateway span to remain separate. but links make waterfall harder to read.
maria: also we need to consider SQS/SNS attribute size limits and Kafka header size. we should keep the payload ~<256 bytes ideally.
priya: agreed. Proposal: encode a tiny handoff token, not full span. token = base64(json: {"tp":"traceparent","span":"spanid","s":"sample","v":1}) + crc32. header name: x-rd-trace.
ana: example header idea:
```
x-rd-trace: eyJ0cCI6IjAwLWFhYi0uLi4iLCJzcGFuIjoiMTIzNDU2IiwicyI6IjAiLCJ2IjoxfQ==.7b3c1a2f
```
worker decode pseudocode:
```
let token = req.headers['x-rd-trace']
let [b64,crc] = token.split('.')
let payload = JSON.parse(atob(b64))
if (crc32(b64) != parseInt(crc,16)) throw Error('token corrupted')
// create new span with parent = payload.tp/span OR attach link
```
josh: question — reparenting to the gateway span means the child latency includes queue time which is confusing. for queue-heavy jobs we prefer link + attribute e.g. "linked_trace": "{...}" then we show side-by-side.
kevin: link is safer when the worker may fork work to other processes. Also some tracing backends (Tempo/Jaeger) show links differently; visualizations still immature.
maria: telemetry/exporter matter: if we include this token we must also emit an attribute on worker spans like `rd.async.link=true` and include the original trace id as `rd.origin_trace` so search queries can join traces in the console.
priya: +1. Add a standardized attribute set: rd.origin_trace_id, rd.origin_span_id, rd.origin_ts, rd.handoff_ttl (seconds). The TTL prevents old traces from being linked after long replays.
ana: implementation plan suggestion:
- gateway: attach x-rd-trace when publishing async (base64 token, CRC, v1)
- worker: if header present, decode. create local span; always add link to origin. optionally if config `reparent_async=true` then reparent instead (feature flag for 2 weeks rollout).
- telemetry: exporter should set attributes per maria's spec and map them to resource attributes for exporter filters.
- UI: Console shows async links in trace view, and a side-panel that can join traces by rd.origin_trace_id.
kevin: rollout concerns: need a no-op compatibility path for older consumers -> if header missing, do nothing. also add unit tests and an integration test using in-memory Kafka.
josh: sampling: if gateway sampled out, we should still consider propagating a "sampled-out" flag so worker can decide to sample. otherwise headless workers will always be unsampled and we lose visibility of partial pipelines.
priya: agree. token should include sample bit and maybe a sampling-hint field. token example payload: {"tp":"00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01","span":"00f067aa0ba902b7","s":"1","v":1}
maria: exporter note: OTLP/tempo will accept span links. ensure our OTLP _mapper_ doesn't drop link attributes. add a unit to check OTLP payload contains links when present.
otel-bot: FYI - linked spans are supported by OTLP v0.11 & most backends, but UI support varies. Jaeger/Tempo treat links as association only; waterfall won't show time-ordered child under parent.
ana: decision (rough consensus): implement compact x-rd-trace token for async transports, default behavior: create local span + attach link + write origin attributes. provide a feature-flag `reparent_async` per service for teams that prefer strict parent-child. include sampling propagation.
kevin: action items:
- eng-platform: publish token spec + header length targets and lib helpers (js/py/go) (owner: kevin)
- eng-runtime: add producer header attachment and batching-safe encoder (owner: priya)
- eng-ml: add OTLP mapper tests to ensure links and attributes are passed (owner: maria)
- devex: add Console UX story for joining traces (owner: josh)
ana: test plan: synthetic end-to-end test using gateway -> kafka -> worker with sampling toggles and long queue delays. compare trace joinability and query performance. run in staging for two weeks behind feature flag.
maria: retention note — linking increases cardinality for some trace queries (origin_trace_id). we should add a telemetry policy: index origin_trace_id for 30 days only, older retention blanks out the field to avoid long-term index growth.
josh: :+1: sounds good. I'm going to draft the spec doc and libs in the repo. will ping when PR up.
ana: thanks all. I'll open the RFC PR with the token schema and unit tests attached. :rocket:
